data.title: Bit Digital (BTBT) Turns Its Ethereum Stash Into a Lending Machine
data.description: On August 13, Bit Digital (NASDAQ:BTBT) reported second-quarter revenue of $32.1 million, up 15% from the prior quarter, while narrowing its net loss to $107.2 million from $146.7 million. But the more interesting move buried in the release wasn’t a growth number. It was how the company chose to fund WhiteFiber’s newest data center: by […]
